facts.claim: Tile geometry: 3857 tiles 256 px; 4326 512 px. Limits stop at TM6 (GeoColor) and TM5 (Band13), but the server serves TM7 and TM6 over Montana.
facts.value: served max TM7 GeoColor, TM6 Band13

facts.claim: Time: PT10M GOES; P1D VIIRS; PT6M *_Granule VIIRS (not decoded). Exact 5-min labels also return distinct frames (GE 02:15Z; BW 02:15Z and 02:35Z).
Montana z5 x6 y11 = lon -112.5 to -101.25, lat 40.98 to 48.92. Montana bbox needs x5-6, y10-11.
Capabilities copies (Age 972 s, 308 s) disagree and omit labels that tiles serve. Each GOES layer lists 100 entries (rolling window).
KVP GetTile with no TIME returns the newest 10-min frame, named in layer-time-actual (02:46Z: GE 02:00Z, GW 01:50Z, BE 02:20Z, BW 02:10Z). TIME works.
404 can fill in late: GE 01:20Z and GW 01:00Z were 404 at 01:51Z and had bytes by 02:36Z (76-96 min after label). Labels can be re-assigned (BW 02:10Z later = 02:15Z bytes).
facts.value: late frames 76-96 min after label; labels unstable

facts.claim: Off-grid is not uniform: some return the floor-10 frame (GE 00:03Z, 02:03Z); some return 404 then 200 two minutes later (GE 00:25Z, 01:05Z; BW 01:05Z).
Opaque imagery confirmed; colour counts reproduced: GE 01:00Z 4131; BE 01:20Z 953 (SD 11.1); GW 01:10Z 4480; BW 01:10Z 1014.
PNG 33-141 KB per 256 px tile (not 48-97 KB). Montana 2x2 box per 10-min step (02:00Z): GE 0.42 MB, BE 0.29 MB, BW 0.28 MB.
facts.value: 33-141 KB per tile; 0.3-0.4 MB per layer per step

facts.claim: Latency 19-45 min after label in 1-min polls (18 transitions). Full-disk Band 13 reaches AWS 9.8-10.1 min after scan start. Served as *_v0_NRT.
GeoColor 1 km at sub-point (NASA article). Band 13 2 km at nadir (netCDF 'spatial_resolution', G19 and G18). TMS 1.22 and 2.45 km are tile-grid sizes.
facts.evidence: CMIPC G19 and G18 netCDF; GeoColor article

facts.claim: Pixel match (eta2 0.98-0.99 at zero shift): GOES-West Band 13 = G18 full-disk scans; GOES-East Band 13 = G19 (2 frames; adjacent scan 0.91). 10-min labels match the scan start in the same bin; exact 02:15Z and 02:35Z match scans 5 min earlier. GeoColor untested.
None of the GIBS, Earthdata, NOAA or GeoColor pages read mention parallax. 5 Band 13 frames register to uncorrected NOAA navigation within one pixel. Cloud-height effects untested.
CORS: every tile response tested has ACAO * (200 and 404) for four Origins incl. 'null'. Preflight 200, ACAO *, no Allow-Methods.
VIIRS NOAA-20 and SNPP 2026-10-17: same all-black 1665 B tile (sentinel). 2026-10-16 valid (11062 and 10557 colours).
BlueMarble_NextGeneration (JPEG, Level8) returns imagery at x5 and x6; ShadedRelief_Bathymetry bytes unchanged (16190 B).
